decisions.reason: The site-list decision does not alter the candidate's capex estimates, capex basis, or shared-cost treatment; network membership remains owned by the source Requirement.
Selecting the Business Case site list does not itself change the operating-cost requirement; the aggregate Opex basis is independently established by another clause in the same message.
The authoritative site-list choice does not change the availability-payment sizing targets or justification criteria.
The site-list decision does not change the debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
Choosing the Business Case site list resolves a model-input conflict but does not alter the standing requirement to annotate assumptions and use supplied materials as reference sources.
The site-list selection does not change the intended audience, investment narrative, or communication-quality requirements.
Resolving which site list to use does not modify the independent requirements for data review, error checking, or modeling quality.
The authoritative site-list choice does not alter the model's presentation or auditability requirements.
